recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait browser game called “Swamp Swagger: Ogre Party Tap.” Preserve the source mechanics: a full-screen canvas with one bottom-anchored central character, a start overlay, a progress meter, pointer/touch taps on the character column that increment one counter, particle/floating-text feedback, a 20-tap transformation burst, a delayed win overlay, and a restart button. Transform presentation into a Shrek-like fairy-tale parody without using licensed names: a lovable green ogre antihero in a swamp, anti-princess humor, crooked castle props, “No Princess Parking” signage, onion/bubble/mud particles, burp-cheer copy, gross-out charm, comic fantasy fonts, and touch-friendly portrait UI for 4:7 to 9:16 screens.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: single-screen tap/progress transformation toy on full-window canvas
- objective: tap the central character enough times to fill a meter and trigger a reveal/victory overlay
- input model: native start/restart buttons plus canvas pointerdown during active play with a generous center-column hit test
- core loop: start -> tap hero -> increment progress -> spawn particles/floating text -> fill HUD meter -> transformation burst -> win overlay -> restart
- fail/friction state: no loss state; friction is only needing enough valid taps and waiting through the reveal timing

## Protected Mechanics
- 20 required valid taps by default through the existing config surface
- requestAnimationFrame canvas loop, bottom-anchored central hero, squash/shake feedback, particle gravity, delayed reveal, and restart reset
- UI buttons remain native click/tap targets and gameplay pointer prevention is scoped to the canvas

## Safe Theming Surfaces
Canvas drawing, particle shapes, GIF feedback, audio URLs from catalogs, HUD labels, overlay copy, palette, fonts, background motifs, and victory language are safe to transform.
